requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Last year I built a four-microphone array beamforming demonstrator: a delay-and-sum beamsteering setup using MEMS microphone breakout boards connected through a USB audio interface, with the beamforming computation running in MATLAB on a laptop.

I characterised the array's directivity pattern by placing a calibration source on a rotating platform at one-metre distance and sweeping the delay weights across a 180-degree arc. I measured the beam patterns, computed the sidelobe levels, and got the setup tracking a moving source in real time using a streaming audio input.

requirements.note: Evidence comes from a self-described personal, unpaid project rather than professional work; candidate explicitly states 'This was not paid work and it was not peer-reviewed.' Whether this satisfies the requirement given the domain (acoustic, not RF) and non-professional context is a judgement call for the recruiter.

requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: Candidate's beamforming demonstrator involves acoustic/audio calibration (microphones, streaming audio input) rather than RF test-bench work (network analysers, spectrum analysers, RF front-end calibration); not treated as addressing this requirement.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: MSc Industrial Engineering, Kallavesi University of Technology, 2015

My formal degree is in industrial engineering, not in electrical engineering or physics, and there are areas in your posting where I simply do not have the track record you are most likely looking for.

lines.quote: Polish national with Finnish permanent residency and full EU work authorisation.
English is the working language across all engineering teams; write and present in English daily.
Currently assigned to a project at the Oulu office and willing to stay for a permanent local role.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real timing constraints?
Can you describe any Python development work you have done that was tested, maintained, and used by others in a production setting?
Can you describe your hands-on RF test-bench experience, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
